quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Matisse Thybulle's defensive impact and anticipation skills
quotes.excerpt: Matisse Thybulle is one of the best steal artists in the game today. He is tricky, quick.
quotes.quote: Matisse Thybulle is one of the best steal artists in the game today. He is tricky, quick, and he can anticipate. He sneaks up on people and gets a lot of steals, but that is not working for Nikola Jokic.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's elite court awareness and passing ability
quotes.excerpt: The skill and expertise of Nikola Jokic buys me time to get the ball out on time.
quotes.quote: The skill and expertise of Nikola Jokic buys me time to get the ball out on time and on target. You see him down, you see him ready to get into the shot. My base is strong, my rhythm is there. So that is the rhythm that you do not have when you are sped up, and it is bought by Nikola Jokic, getting the ball out on time, on target, at the most vulnerable state to get back to a closeout.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon's role as a connector and defensive decoy
quotes.excerpt: Aaron Gordon has his eyes on the defense and is pointing towards you.
quotes.quote: Aaron Gordon has his eyes on the defense and Aaron Gordon is pointing towards you. I feel like that is an underrated play in that play, that Aaron Gordon is pointing towards you. He definitely knows that there is a double coming, but him having his eyes on Aaron Gordon and Aaron Gordon pointing towards you solidifies it.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon's role as a connector in Denver's offense
quotes.excerpt: Aaron Gordon is a connector. Of course, it is a great cut by Christian Braun.
quotes.quote: Aaron Gordon is a connector. Of course, it is a great cut by Christian Braun to take the corner. It makes Dario Saric have to make a decision. This is huge. If he does not cut this corner, Dario Saric is staying in the middle and can get to either shooter. But because he has to take this step to get down, he is out of the play.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's ability to manipulate defense with ball fakes
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic comes off, he fakes it, Rudy Gobert bites, Nikola Jokic goes downhill.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic comes off, he fakes it, Rudy Gobert bites, Nikola Jokic goes downhill. Nikola Jokic is going to have a dunk if Terrence Shannon Jr. does not help. I had just set the screen, so ideally, I am lower so Terrence Shannon Jr. is not in help, but because I literally just set a screen, I have to be where I am at.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's playmaking creates easier shots for teammates
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic created an environment where it is an easier shot now.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic created an environment where it is an easier shot now. If he picks it up with two, jump stops and kicks it, Terrence Shannon Jr. is on my doorstep. I might not even shoot it, I might drive it, I might shoot a contested shot, but because the ball is out of Nikola Jokic's hands and he has not even reacted back out yet, that buys me the time to get into that full strong shot.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Elite playmakers manipulate spacing and defensive rotations
quotes.excerpt: They will get the ball to you if you find the window.
quotes.quote: They will get the ball to you if you find the window. They will manipulate spacing, they will manipulate defensive rotations, they will manipulate coverages, and so you can succeed a lot when you give them passing windows.
